name: Shelly Plus RGBW PM
summary: 12/24VDC 4-channel PWM LED strip controller (RGBW/RGB/4x mono) with per-channel power metering.

extra.profiles: rgbw, rgb, light (4 independent mono channels)
extra.max_current_note: max_current_a is DC per channel (no AC output)

gotchas: DC-only: needs a separate 12/24V LED driver; it does not run from mains
Single white channel — no tunable-white/CCT (RGBWW); for that see Shelly Pro RGBWW PM
4A per channel but 10A total across all outputs
833 Hz default PWM can whine; 22 kHz mode reduces noise but degrades low-brightness color accuracy
Mains wall switches need a Shelly 1/4-Channel Decoupler 120V to drive its DC inputs
best_for: 12/24V RGBW or 4-zone mono LED strip installs with energy monitoring
